name: @w6w-apps/github
description: Manage GitHub issues, pull requests, releases, files, repositories and Actions workflows.

w6w.longDescription:
GitHub gives a workflow a broad surface across the pieces engineering teams actually script around — reading and writing repository files, creating, commenting on, locking and updating issues, and reviewing and merging pull requests without a human opening a browser.

Releases are fully manageable (created, updated, listed and deleted), and GitHub Actions workflows can be listed, enabled and dispatched, so a process outside GitHub can kick off a CI run or ship a release as one of its own steps. Repository- and organization-level reads — a repository's issues, its license, a user's or an organization's repositories — cover the discovery a workflow needs before acting on a specific one.

A natural fit for release automation, issue triage pulled in from another system, PR review gating, or triggering CI/CD from an event GitHub itself doesn't know about.
